summary: Built and verified the PII-Zero 3-platform Zero-Trust Hybrid AI Airlock: React 19 + TypeScript Web Workbench & Node HTTP Server, Chrome Extension (Manifest V3 Side Panel + Context Menu + 1-click inline redaction packaged to dist-artifacts/piizero-chrome-extension.zip), and Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Firebase AI Logic + FoldingFeature Foldable Android App (compiled and packaged to dist-artifacts/piizero-android-debug.apk).

web.framework: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Node 22 HTTP Server
web.sdk: firebase/ai (InferenceMode.PREFER_ON_DEVICE, ONLY_ON_DEVICE, ONLY_IN_CLOUD) + Chrome LanguageModel Nano 4 bridge

limitations: Live Firebase AI Logic cloud/on-device calls use user-supplied Firebase config or Chrome Built-in Gemini Nano 4 when available, and automatically fall back to the deterministic local HIPAA/FRE-502 airlock engine so all three platforms run offline out-of-the-box.
